command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
LIVE=$ROOT/buehne.html
PRE=$(sha256sum "$LIVE" | awk '{print $1}')
echo PRE_LIVE_SHA=$PRE
echo '=== DIRECT_TEXT_REFERENCES ==='
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual')
needles=('kopf_rgba_parallax','alpha_summe_identisch','grenzen','depth_map','DepthAnything','depth-anything','parallax')
exts={'.py','.json','.md','.txt','.html','.js','.sh'}
rows=[]
for p in root.rglob('*'):
    if not p.is_file() or p.suffix.lower() not in exts: continue
    try: t=p.read_text(errors='replace')
    except Exception: continue
    hits=[n for n in needles if n in t]
    if hits:
        rows.append((str(p.relative_to(root)),hits))
for rel,hits in sorted(rows): print(rel, '::', ','.join(hits))
PY
echo '=== CANDIDATE_GENERATOR_HASHES ==='
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,re
root=Path('/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual')
patterns=re.compile(r'(parallax|depth|tiefe|slice)',re.I)
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
    if not p.is_file() or p.suffix.lower() not in {'.py','.sh','.js','.json','.md'}: continue
    if patterns.search(p.name) or patterns.search(str(p.parent)):
        try: b=p.read_bytes()
        except Exception: continue
        print(hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), len(b), str(p.relative_to(root)))
PY
POST=$(sha256sum "$LIVE" | awk '{print $1}')
echo POST_LIVE_SHA=$POST
test "$PRE" = "$POST"
echo LIVE_MUTATION=0
